source: RFC 0014 R1 on stored records and G5 (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24, after the red-team review CE-9, CE-10, CE-15); RFC 0014 §5 (sentences proposed in the PR); RFC 0014 G3
statement: Every stored record the reader's rule refuses is counted by its kind of record and its reason (cosec.stored.refused{record, reason}), both closed sets: later for a record a later version wrote (a later format, or a member its crit names that this version does not know), malformed for one that is not a record of its kind. The count is kept per process, whichever store or caller read the record, and registered with cosec-micrometer and a MeterRegistry: a non-zero rate of later during a rolling upgrade is an instance still to upgrade, and ends when every instance runs the later version.
guards: micrometer:StoredRefusedMetricTest#each series reads the count of its record and reason, and the series are the closed sets only
document:StoredCritTest#a member crit names that this version does not know refuses the record as a later version's, and counts it
document:StoredCritTest#a crit that is not one, or a record that is not one, is malformed, and counts as malformed
